Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 26

“For those free of desire and anger, restrained in thought, who have known the self, the peace of Brahman exists all around them.”

Abhitah, all around, is the word that matters. This peace is not waiting at the end of a road but already surrounding those who have become able to perceive it.
